race.comment: Race absolutely decimated by scratchings. EVICTION NOTICE (6) comes a fair way back in grade from a brave run in the Listed The Rosebud at Rosehill last start, fading to finish eighth behind impressive winner Chilly Girl. He's had a few chances but largely in better company and this suits nicely. PEYTON (9) resumes. He was last seen running second by a head to St Gotthard who then bolted in with a good race in Queensland. Fitted with two trials for this and Lloyd rides from the inside gate. BOLD BUCKS (5) returns from a lay-off. Fitter for a recent trial at Rosehill. Opened last campaign with a fourth at Scone over 1000m. Can feature. NOT ON MY WATCH (8) three-year-old gelding on debut. Market watch advised.
